title: Lument Continues to Grow Debt Capital Markets Platform with the Addition of Israel Leiner
summary: Israel Leiner joins Lument as DCM Managing Director, bolstering tailored debt placement and capital stack solutions for CRE clients nationwide.
body_markdown:
*****Multifamily finance veteran strengthens the firm’s debt capabilities across key growth markets nationwide.*****


**New York, NY — September 16, 2026 —** Lument announced today that Israel Leiner has joined its Debt Capital Markets (DCM) team as a managing director. Based in New Jersey, Leiner will originate debt and preferred equity financing solutions for commercial real estate clients nationwide. He reports to Rick Warren, senior managing director and head of real estate capital markets at Lument.


“As borrowers seek creative financing solutions in an increasingly complex market, Israel brings a strong track record of execution and a client-first mindset. We are thrilled to bring him on board to further bolster our platform,” said Warren. “His track record in New York-New Jersey and his established business in key growth markets such as the Philadelphia metro area, Atlanta, and other Sunbelt markets further strengthen our ability to serve.”


Prior to joining Lument, Leiner served as a managing director, capital markets, with Walker & Dunlop. Before that, he was vice president at Meridian Capital Group. Throughout his career, he has closed more than 200 loans totaling over $2 billion in financing. His expertise spans construction, bridge, and permanent financing across apartment, office, and retail assets, with multifamily transactions accounting for most of his production. He also brings extensive experience sourcing capital from banks, debt funds, life insurance companies, CMBS lenders, and private capital providers.


“What attracted me to Lument is how well the platform aligns with the clients and transactions I’ve spent my career serving,” said Leiner. “With access to a wide range of capital sources and the ability to tailor solutions across the capital stack, Lument is well positioned to help borrowers navigate a complex market. I’m excited to join a team that is continuing to invest in growth and expand what’s possible for its clients.”


Lument’s DCM platform provides borrowers with access to debt and preferred equity solutions from a wide range of capital sources, including banks, debt funds, life companies, conduits, and Lument’s proprietary capital. Lument has completed over $1.9 billion in debt placement volume since launching its DCM platform in 2024.


**About Lument**
Lument, a subsidiary of ORIX Corporation USA, is a national leader in commercial real estate finance and delivers a comprehensive set of capital solutions customized for investors in multifamily, affordable housing, and seniors housing and healthcare real estate. Lument offers Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, FHA, USDA, and balance sheet financing, as well as a full suite of capital markets lending products. In addition, Lument provides a suite of real estate advisory solutions including real estate investment sales, investment banking, and investment management solutions. The company has approximately 550 employees in over 30 offices across the United States. Securities, investment banking, and advisory services are provided through Lument Securities, LLC, member FINRA/SIPC. Lument Investment Management, LLC, is registered as an investment adviser with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. For more information, visit[www.lument.com](http://www.lument.com/) .
